prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Potential Companions", "Hover over or tap any pet to see how they behave on your desktop."]
1: ["Testing Desktop Overlay Rendering", "We are verifying screen permissions to make sure your pet can roam freely on top of your windows.", "Test Pet Display"]
2: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Adopt a ready-to-play companion instantly or craft a custom pet from photos.", "Instant Adopt vs Custom Creator"]
3: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try out these essential shortcut controls to get comfortable with your new desktop companion.", "Start Playing", "Quick Controls Overview"]
4: ["Signing in ensures your pets and custom desktop setups are safely backed up to your account.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
5: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access the quick hide menu."]
6: ["Select Your Journey & Unlock Starter Perks", "Includes Exclusive Desktop Toy"]
7: ["Use well-lit photos with clear contrast between your pet and the background for best results.", "Recommended: Bright lighting, centered subject, no heavy blur."]
8: ["Taking longer than usual? Check your network connection or try guest mode."]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready to Explore Your Desktop!", "Look down at your desktop taskbar to see your new pet in action.", "Enter Desktop Mode"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests getting around a required step
